run_plot_vector_fields: run the script to generate a comparison figure of different vector field schemes and save it as vector_fields.png
create_plot_vector_fields: create a figure comparing vector field schemes by calling plot_vector_fields with a custom dimension and interval
review_plot_vector_field: review the private _plot_vector_field function that overlays an array with a vector field using imshow and quiver
summarize_sample: summarize the _sample helper function that selects every Nth element from a 2D JAX array
refactor_plot_polarization_elipses: refactor the _plot_polarization_elipses function to customize the ellipse scale or line width for complex vector fields
